record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: HIPPOPOTAS (1 star) and HIPPODOWN (2 stars) declare SAND_TOMB (passive SAND_STREAM, maxPP 100, range 1). The strategy is shared; damage and status duration depend on the casting unit's stars. The SAND_STREAM passive is a separate identifier and is not covered. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Single-target: the cast target is Paralysed and Silenced for the same requested duration (raw table 3000 / 5000 / 8000 / 16000 ms by caster stars: HIPPOPOTAS 3000, HIPPODOWN 5000) and then takes special damage (raw table 10 / 20 / 40 / 80: HIPPOPOTAS 10, HIPPODOWN 20). Order in the strategy: paralysis, silence, damage. Neither status duration is AP-scaled (triggerParalysis is called without apBoost; triggerSilence has no AP parameter) and neither depends on crit. Statuses are applied independently of the damage result, so a protected / skydiving / magicBounce target still gets both (subject to Rune Protect, IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS, and the Tree flag for silence). Requested duration/damage, applied duration (after weather and duration reductions, and the keep-the-larger timer rule) and the damage returned as takenDamage (shield damage included, unused here) are different amounts. No heal, PP gain or shield is part of this ability, so the shared heal rules (core-mechanics.md section J) do not apply.

effects.scaling: requested = 10 (HIPPOPOTAS) / 20 (HIPPODOWN). Applied: x(1 + caster AP/100) (apBoost default true); crit factor 1 + (critPower - 1) x reduction only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT; canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: handleSpecialDamage returns {death:false, takenDamage:0} and deals nothing when the target is protected, skydiving or has magicBounce (magicBounce reflects damage x star factor to the caster unless it holds Protective Pads). Otherwise PokemonState.handleDamage: special damage / (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), armorReduction halves speDef, minimum 1 after Math.ceil, shield absorbs first, enraged attacker multiplier. Three amounts: requested = table; applied = after AP / crit / defense / floor of 1; takenDamage (returned, includes shield damage, unused here). Damage is dealt last, after both statuses.

statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit: apBoost is left at its default false, so no (1 + AP/100) factor
statusEffects.applicationOrder: first, before silence and the damage
statusEffects.guards: not applied with runeProtect or IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS; STORM weather multiplies the duration by 1.3, then by (1 - 0.2 x ELECTRIC_QUARTZ count of the target's player) if any; then the target's duration reductions (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, HYDRATION x0.5, WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, ODD_KEYSTONE -10% each, rounded). Timer rule: `if (duration > paralysisCooldown) paralysisCooldown = round(duration)`, the larger of the remaining time and the new reduced request. A CHERI_BERRY holder eats the berry after a successful application.
statusEffects.resolution: Requested vs applied: applied duration is the table value after the weather and reduction steps and the keep-the-larger rule.
statusEffects.combatEffect: a paralysed unit uses half speed for its attack cooldown and movement speed, and cannot dodge basic attacks. Other uses of status.paralysis were not read here (see the ZAP_CANNON candidate).

statusEffects.scaling: none: triggerSilence has no apBoost parameter, no AP or crit factor
statusEffects.applicationOrder: second, after paralysis and before the damage
statusEffects.guards: not applied if the target's status has runeProtect or the tree flag; MURKY weather multiplies the duration by 1.3; then the target's duration reductions as above. Timer rule: `if (duration > silenceCooldown) { silenceCooldown = duration; silenceOrigin = origin }` (not rounded); the silence flag is set true even when the timer is not extended.
statusEffects.resolution: Requested vs applied: applied duration is the table value after the MURKY and reduction steps and the keep-the-larger rule. Ends when the cooldown runs out (updateSilence).
statusEffects.combatEffect: canCast is false while silenced (also false with Nullify Bandana or TELEPORT_NEXT_ATTACK), and the attacking state's cast gate requires canCast. Other readers of status.silence were not audited.

starBehavior.note: Damage and status duration are both indexed by the casting entity's stars (fallbacks 80 and 16000). Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None; the target is whatever the cast target is.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Single mode. Each cast spends maxPP (100) of PP. A repeat cast extends a status only if the new reduced duration exceeds the remaining time; the silenced caster-target pair has no stored state beyond silenceOrigin.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: paralysis and silence for 3000 / 5000 ms raw, special damage 10 / 20 raw. Applied: statuses after guards (Rune Protect, IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS, Tree), weather, reductions and the keep-the-larger rule; damage after AP, crit, speDef and the floor of 1 (zero if protected / skydiving / magicBounce; statuses are still applied in that case).
